subject: Consolidated renewal packet and sequencing for MSA + order form
messages:
From: Sam Park <sam.park@cloudopsinc.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Ngolo <aisha.ngolo@cloudopsinc.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal paperwork + capacity uplift (Q1 2027)

Michael —

Thanks again for the renewal estimate. We took the numbers to Procurement and Legal; they pushed back on a few items and asked us to return a consolidated redline (MSA + order form) so they can sign off in one pass. Primary asks from their side:

- Move to a 24-month term instead of 12 (pricing unchanged)
- Add a 20% capacity uplift effective 2027-01-01 (billing schedule needs to reflect pro-rated month)
- Clarify audit/data retention language and SOC2 evidence cadence
- SLA credits language: want cap on credits and notice window adjusted to 72 hours

I've attached their internal markups for our reference (see CloudOps_Redline_MSAV2.docx). Can you confirm who on your side should own consolidation vs legal redline? Procurement would like to close this week if possible.

Thanks —
Sam
Director of Procurement
CloudOps Inc
[attachment: CloudOps_Redline_MSAV2.docx (docx, 92KB)]

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@cloudopsinc.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork + capacity uplift (Q1 2027)

Sam —

Appreciate the clear list. I'm looping in Marissa (Sales Ops) and Naomi (CS lead) — we'll own the consolidation and respond with a single tracked-changes packet. High level plan from our side:

1) Marissa will reconcile the Order Form (capacity schedule & pro-rate math) and produce v3 of the order form (attach xlsx).
2) I'll coordinate MSA redline responses with Legal for the data retention / SOC2 items. Naomi will confirm product-side delivery dates for the uplift and confirm any migration windows.
3) We'll aim to return a single redline packet (MSA + order form plus short summary PDF) by EOD Wednesday (18 Nov). If Procurement needs faster, propose a 30-minute call tomorrow to accelerate.

Two quick clarifications:
- For the 24-month term, do you want auto-renewal language updated or leave as-is?
- The 20% uplift — is that committed capacity (invoiceable) or a burst/bucket? That affects how we present billing.

If you can confirm the above, we'll proceed.

Best,
Michael Grant
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.com | (415) 555-0187

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@cloudopsinc.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork + capacity uplift (Q1 2027)

Sam / Michael —

Attached: OrderForm_CapacitySchedule_v3.xlsx and a short Redline_Summary.pdf that maps CloudOps' asks to our proposed edits. Notes below (high level):

- Term / Auto-renew: We can accept 24 months. Recommend we explicitly set auto-renew to 12-month increments post-term and include a 90-day termination window prior to renew. That preserves our standard exit cadence.
- Capacity uplift: We propose treating the 20% as committed capacity (invoiceable). To reduce friction, we show the pro-rate math on the first invoice month in the xlsx; request Procurement confirm they accept one upfront pro-rated invoice.
- Audit / SOC2: Naomi will own the evidence cadence. Our standard response: quarterly SOC2 attestations + annual audit artifacts; for tight compliance requests we can offer a bi-annual peer review but it requires SOC-2 report sharing under NDA.
- SLA credits: We are okay with adjusting the notice window to 72 hours; however, we prefer the credit cap to remain language-based (per-incident cap equal to monthly bill) — if CloudOps needs a lower cap, we can soften via a mutual cap table.

Action items and owners:
- Marissa: finalize order form numbers and generate redline (DONE, attached)
- Michael: propose tracked MSA responses and push to legal for review (hold until confirmation on auto-renew)
- Naomi: prepare short evidence note with SOC2 schedule + a one-pager describing what we can share under NDA

If Procurement wants to sign this week, I recommend a 30-min legal triage with CloudOps' counsel and our legal to iron out the SOC2/data-retention language — Marissa and I can host. Are mornings on Wednesday good?

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
[attachments: OrderForm_CapacitySchedule_v3.xlsx, Redline_Summary.pdf]

From: Aisha Ngolo <aisha.ngolo@cloudopsinc.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Park <sam.park@cloudopsinc.com>, procurement@cloudopsinc.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork + capacity uplift (Q1 2027)

Marissa / Michael —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We reviewed the OrderForm_CapacitySchedule_v3.xlsx and the Redline_Summary. A few notes from Legal:

- Auto-renew language: CloudOps prefers no auto-renew for the first renewal only (i.e., at contract end parties must explicitly re-execute). Is Redwood able to accept opt-in for the first renewal?
- Data retention: we marked a clause to require 7 years retention for audit logs — that's non-negotiable internally. Can you provide the exact retention mechanics (where logs are stored and how long) in writing? Naomi's one-pager should cover this.
- SOC2 evidence: we will accept quarterly attestations but need a firm timeline for delivery after the reporting period (30 days).
- SLA credits: procurement agreed to the 72-hour notice but requests the per-incident cap be 50% of monthly bill (they will not accept a full-month cap).

We can do a 30-min call tomorrow 09:00 PT if that works for the Redwood legal + Marissa. I will have our counsel on standby for the redline session.

Regards,
Aisha Ngolo
Senior Counsel | CloudOps Inc
[attachment: CloudOps_Legal_MSA_comments.pdf (pdf, 28KB)]

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Ngolo <aisha.ngolo@cloudopsinc.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Park <sam.park@cloudopsinc.com>, procurement@cloudopsinc.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidated renewal packet and sequencing for MSA + order form

Thanks everyone — quick internal confirmation and next steps from Redwood: 

- Auto-renew: We cannot accept a firm no-auto-renew for the first renewal across all customers; however, for strategic accounts we can add an explicit opt-out clause that requires notice 60 days prior to renewal. For CloudOps we can set that opt-out in the order form as a one-off concession.
- Data retention / audit logs: Naomi will send the one-pager by EOD with exact retention mechanics (storage location, retention window, export process). We'll attach that under NDA.
- SOC2 evidence timing: we accept 30 days post-period delivery. We'll include this in the MSA exhibit.
- SLA credits: We can move from a full-month per-incident cap to 50% of monthly bill for this committed order but need executive approval for the concession — pulling legal + finance into the call tomorrow will speed approval.

Call: Redwood legal (TBD) + Marissa + Naomi will join 09:00 PT tomorrow (Fri, 20 Nov). Please send the DocuSign envelope once we finalize the tracked packet so Procurement can route for signature. I'll circulate the consolidated tracked-changes packet immediately after the call.

Next deliverables: consolidated packet (MSA tracked + OrderForm_v3 + Redline_Summary) and DocuSign link; target: post-call Friday EOD.

Best,
Michael Grant
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
